title: Interdimensional portal in Secret Canyon

tellings.quote: And more importantly, there's a place called Secret Canyon where there's allegedly a portal. Some kind of interdimensional portal.

plain: A place called Secret Canyon, near Sedona in Arizona, is said to hold "some kind of interdimensional portal", a doorway to some other realm. The Australian journalist Ross Coulthart passes this on to Michels as something he was told, and he frames it as an allegation.
